=INSERT INTO public.posts (
  title, slug, excerpt, content, category, tags, featured_image, status, views, source_url, source_name, author_name
) VALUES (
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.title) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.slug) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.excerpt) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.content) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.category) }},
  ARRAY[{{ $json.tags.map(t => JSON.stringify(t)).join(',') }}],
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.featured_image) }},
  'published',
  0,
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.rawLink) }},
  'TechPulse AI Wire',
  'TechPulse Editorial Bot'
) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;
